name: Civil Air Patrol Cadets, Santa Barbara Composite Squadron 131
org: Civil Air Patrol, Santa Barbara Composite Squadron 131
what_you_do: Join weekly squadron meetings. You get hands-on flight time, STEM projects and leadership milestones. Cadets can serve on search and rescue missions as a Ground Team Member or Mission Radio Operator. They can also help at community events.
pay_detail: Civil Air Patrol says annual dues are $25 to $50 depending on location, and a fully active cadet may spend $300 to $600 in the first year (minus financial help). The squadron pages do not list its own dues.
duration: The squadron meets every Wednesday from 6:00 to 8:30 p.m. and has one Saturday activity a month.
deadline_text: No deadline. Contact the squadron to schedule a visit.
how_to_apply: Contact the squadron to set up a visit (the page says to let them know you are interested so they can schedule one). Meetings are at 629 Firestone Rd # B, Goleta, CA 93117. Phone: 805-822-4817. Email: Tyler.Epley@cawgcap.org (Deputy Commander for Cadets).
notes: Confirm first: the squadron pages do not list dues. The dues range and first-year cost come from the national Civil Air Patrol cadet page.
